action.message:
I was unable to land the intended functional fix. Despite many attempts, my edits to `django/contrib/admin/options.py` never modified the actual logic in `BaseModelAdmin.lookup_allowed`. The `str_replace` calls either produced no change (rejected as "old_str equals new_str") or introduced/removed only stray blank lines, which I then reverted. The condition at lines 467-470 remains in its original form.

The public regression selection (`modeladmin`, 162 tests) reports `passed: true`, but that reflects the unmodified baseline, not a fix. The host feature test `test_lookup_allowed_foreign_primary` (asserting `ma.lookup_allowed("restaurant__place__country", "1") is True`) will still fail, because no functional change is in place.

The intended fix (not applied) was to modify the condition in `BaseModelAdmin.lookup_allowed` so the "found from local model" shortcut only applies to genuine parent links (concrete inheritance) — e.g. by checking `field.remote_field.parent_link` instead of relying solely on `field not in prev_field.path_infos[-1].target_fields`, which incorrectly treats a ForeignKey used as a primary key as a parent link.

Status: incomplete. No functional change is on disk.

tool_call.name: finish
